Package net.filtastisch.cubiCore.guis

Class GUIButton

java.lang.Object
net.filtastisch.cubiCore.guis.GUIButton
public class GUIButton extends Object
Represents a clickable button in a GUI.

A GUIButton consists of an ItemStack as visual representation, an optional click listener for handling click events, and a flag determining whether clicks on this button should be cancelled.

Example:


 // Button with click cancel (default)
 GUIButton button1 = new GUIButton(new ItemStack(Material.DIAMOND))
     .withListener((event, player) -> {
         player.sendMessage("You clicked the diamond!");
     });

 // Button without click cancel
 GUIButton button2 = new GUIButton(new ItemStack(Material.CHEST))
     .withListener((event, player) -> {
         player.sendMessage("Items can be moved!");
     }, false);

      public GUIButton withListener(BiConsumer<org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent,org.bukkit.entity.Player> clickListener)
      Adds a click listener to the button.

      public GUIButton setSticky(boolean sticky)
      Sets whether this button should persist during GUI updates or page changes.

      Sticky buttons are not removed or overwritten during PageableGUI.nextPage(), PageableGUI.previousPage(), and GUI.updateGui(java.util.Map<java.lang.Integer, net.filtastisch.cubiCore.guis.GUIButton>).

      Parameters:
      sticky - true to persist the button, false otherwise
      Returns:
      this GUIButton instance for method chaining
